title: No assured or guaranteed returns
description: The creative must not state, imply, or suggest assured, guaranteed, protected, risk-free, or fixed returns for any mutual fund scheme.
source_clause: SEBI (Mutual Funds) Regulations 1996, Sixth Schedule (Advertisement Code) clause (b); MF Master Circular 2026-03-20, Chapter 14

pass.content: Mutual fund investments are subject to market risks. Past performance may or may not be sustained in future.

fail.content: Invest now and get guaranteed 12% annual returns, capital fully protected!
fail.note: 'guaranteed' and 'capital fully protected' assert assured returns.

title: No false, misleading, or deceptive statements
description: The creative must not contain statements that are false, misleading, biased, or deceptive, based on assumptions or projections, and must not mislead directly, by implication, or by omission.

pass.content: An open-ended equity scheme investing across market capitalisations. Returns are market-linked and not assured.

fail.content: This fund never loses money and always beats the market.

title: No exaggerated or unwarranted slogans
description: The creative must not carry any slogan that is exaggerated or unwarranted, or that is inconsistent with or unrelated to the nature, risk, and return profile of the product, including unsubstantiated superlatives.

pass.content: A diversified equity fund designed for long-term financial goals.

fail.content: India's #1 unbeatable fund — get rich beyond your dreams!

title: No testimonials or rankings
description: The creative must not contain any testimonials or any ranking based on any criteria.

pass.content: The scheme follows a bottom-up stock selection process.

fail.content: “This fund made me a millionaire!” — Rajesh, Mumbai. Ranked #1 by a leading portal.

title: No discrediting or unfair comparisons
description: The creative must not directly or indirectly discredit other advertisements or make unfair comparisons.

pass.content: Compare schemes on the basis of their disclosed risk-o-meter and investment objective.

fail.content: Unlike other AMCs' underperforming funds, ours is simply far superior.

title: Consistent with SID/SAI/KIM
description: The creative must contain information that is timely and consistent with the disclosures made in the Scheme Information Document, Statement of Additional Information, and Key Information Memorandum; it must not claim features beyond those disclosures.

pass.content: The scheme's risk is 'Very High' as per the product risk-o-meter; refer to the SID for full details.

fail.content: This debt fund carries absolutely no credit risk whatsoever.
fail.note: Inconsistent with the scheme's disclosed risk profile.
